newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says domestic WPI up due to sales tax rise.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says domestic WPI up due to sales tax rise.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) said on Friday that a rise in the domestic wholesale price index (WPI) in the first 10 days of April was in reaction to an increase in the sales tax on April 1.
The central bank said that apart from the sales tax rise, there was no basic change in the trend of the WPI.
"The rise of the sales tax has been reflected significantly in the WPI (during the first 10 days of April)," the BOJ said.
The domestic WPI, a key component of the overall WPI, rose 1.9 percent in the first 10 days of April from the previous 10-day period and was up 1.9 percent from a year earlier.
In the April interim period, the overall WPI was up 1.5 percent from the previous 10-day period and up 3.1 percent from a year earlier.
